message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a self-watering planter of steel with a plastic liner. Candidate headings are 7323 (table, kitchen or other household articles of iron or steel), 7325/7326 (other articles of iron or steel), 3924 (plastic household articles), and 6914 (ceramic).

I recall CBP classifying steel flower pots and planters in 7323.99.90 (other household articles of iron or steel, not enameled or coated with porcelain). Planters of iron or steel have often been placed in 7323.99.9060 ("Other: Other"), though some rulings went to 7326.90.8688 (other articles of iron or steel). I believe the planter-with-plastic-liner rulings generally classify as household articles under 7323, since the planter is a household article in steel.

The steel is the essential character, so I'm going with 7323.99.9060, "Other, other, other" in the 7323.99 subheading.

Within 7323.99.90, the statistical suffixes I remember are 7323.99.9060 (other, not coated or plated with precious metal) and 7323.99.9080 (other). I'm not fully certain which applies here. The 9060 suffix covers "Other," and the 7323.99.90 subheading also has 9005 for items such as cooking and kitchen ware. I'll settle on 7323.99.9080.
